context: Mei brings baby Hikari to visit; Hina is fascinated.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: メイお姉さん、ひかりちゃん、本当に、小さい！
lines.style: Bright, breathy wonder. Quick discovery at the start. Warm amazement throughout. Child's natural inflection — unselfconscious, genuine delight.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Hehe, do you want to hold her?
lines.style: Soft, inviting warmth. Genuine offer with no pressure underneath. Gentle smile in the voice. Settling into the moment together.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: え、いいの？怖い…でも、嬉しい！
lines.en: Really? I'm scared… but I'm so happy!
lines.style: Quick intake of breath. Honest contradiction — fear and joy held at the same time. Trembling slightly under the excitement. Child's unguarded vulnerability.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Quiet, steady guidance. The voice of experience without instruction. Barely above a whisper. Hand-like steadiness in each word.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: …Oh wow, so warm. She's really cute.
lines.style: Awestruck, almost to herself. Pause before the first word. Soft, reverent tone. Wonder settling in. Child discovering tenderness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ひな、本当に、優しい、お姉さん、だね。
lines.en: Hina — you're truly a kind big sister.
lines.style: Warm recognition. Slow, genuine. Not flattering — seeing her clearly. Affection settles like a blanket. Eye-contact softness in the delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: こうやって、家族、繋がっていくの、本当に、嬉しい。
lines.en: This is how family bonds grow — it makes me truly happy.
lines.style: Reflective, deep warmth. Slight pause before speaking. Watching the moment, not narrating it. Voice carries quiet weight and contentment.
